curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What really happened in the final mystery that defeated the legendary detective and compelled him to abandon his life's work?
curatedMovie.description: In 1947, an aging Sherlock Holmes faces the limits of his fading memory. Nearing the end of his life, he leans on his housekeeper's young son to piece together the unresolved case that originally forced his retirement.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Slow, reflective, and emotionally heavy. A thoughtful drama demanding engaged attention for a quiet night alone.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Bill Condon reframes an iconic sleuth into a fragile figure, swapping deduction for a poignant, thoughtful portrait of aging, fading memory, and regret.
